info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Details-v3-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Details Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about pets available for adoption. It provides comprehensive data on various pets, including their breeds, sizes, ages, and adoption statuses. This endpoint is particularly useful for animal shelters, adoption agencies, and prospective pet owners seeking to browse and evaluate pets for adoption. By utilizing this API, developers can integrate pet data into their applications, enhancing user experience and facilitating the adoption process.

get.summary: Retrieve detailed information about a specific pet.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch comprehensive details of a specified pet, including its characteristics, status, and other relevant information. Ensure to provide the necessary parameters to identify the pet for which details are desired.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and pet details are returned.
